caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a dark green upholstered seat, positioned slightly angled to display three of its four legs and the decorative backrest. The chair's wooden frame is rendered in shades of brown with detailed shading to suggest three-dimensionality. The backrest has an oval, shield-like shape with vertical, carved elements and a central spindle, all in the same brown tone as the frame. The seat is a dark, nearly black-green color, trimmed with a row of small, regularly spaced brass or gold-colored tacks along the bottom edge. The chair stands on four legs, each depicted with sharp, angular lines, and the two front legs are shown with simple geometric carvings near the foot. The drawing is centered within a light beige or off-white background, bounded by a thin pencil-drawn border, and is signed in the lower right corner with the name "Tivingsloke."
title: Side Chair
